editorial.blurb: Chicago's legendary deep-dish destination delivers rich, cheesy layers that live up to the hype—just come hungry and ready to wait.
editorial.insiderTip: Pre-order your pizza online before arriving to avoid surprises; plan for a 45-50 minute bake time, and arrive outside peak dinner hours (around 6 PM) to skip the line.

topDishes.note: Rich layers of cheese, toppings, and sauce—mind-blowing on first bite
Absolutely amazing; the signature deep-dish that justifies the wait
